articles.title: Muqarnas Vault
articles.summary: Nested square frames stepping inward in teal, gold, magenta and charcoal, glossy metallic, like stacked tiles. A bright tiled mosaic of nested squares in yellow, magenta, blue and green on a dark ground; reads as a loud geometric quilt with gold grout.
articles.what: Stepped niches corbelling inward, every tier smaller than the one it hangs from. Up close: A tiled field of square cells about 90 px wide, each a set of concentric squares stepping inward, outlined in thin bronze-gold lines. Every ring is a speckled flat colour: yellow, magenta, teal-blue, green or maroon, in different orders cell to cell, with a few smaller cells nested into corners. From a distance: A bright tiled mosaic of nested squares in yellow, magenta, blue and green on a dark ground; reads as a loud geometric quilt with gold grout. Measured spec (average): metal 172, roughness 55, coat 72. Shine: gloss. Metal: high. It brings its own colours.
